definition: [ גָּנַן ] verb cover, surround, defend (Arabic , Aramaic אַגֵּן (Aph`el), Palmyrene אגן Vog Palm.132 ff. ) — Qal Perfect וְגַנּוֺתִי Isa 37:35 + 3 t.; Infinitive absolute גָּנוֺן Isa 31:5 (c. Hiph`il q. v.) — defend , subject always ׳ י ; object the city Jerusalem with על Isa 37:35 ; Isa 38:6 = 2Kgs 20:6 ; 2Kgs 19:34 with אֶלֿ (|| הוֺשִׁיעַ ). Hiph`il Imperfect — or Qal according to Ba ZMG 1889, 178 , who compare Arabic — יָגֵן Isa 31:5 + 2 t. — defend (= Qal), Jerusalem Isa 31:5 יגן גָּ֗֗֗נוֺן with על (|| הִצִּיל ); object Yahweh's people Zech 9:15 with על , Zech 12:8 with בְּעַד .
